plugins.name: 飞书 / Lark
plugins.summary: Feishu / Lark for Locus scripts: sign in on the plugin's settings page, then read and write wiki pages, documents, sheets, bases, drive files, chats and messages through locus.lark in Python.

summaryI18n.en: Feishu / Lark for Locus scripts: sign in on the plugin's settings page, then read and write wiki pages, documents, sheets, bases, drive files, chats and messages through locus.lark in Python.
summaryI18n.zh: 在 Locus 脚本中读写飞书 / Lark：在插件设置页登录后，通过 Python 的 locus.lark 访问知识库、云文档、电子表格、多维表格、云空间、群聊和消息。
